name.value: French Beach Provincial Park Group Site

description.value: Oceanside campground on the Strait of Juan de Fuca with a 1,600m sand-and-pebble beach, lush forest trails, and prime whale-watching; reached via paved Highway 14 and open year-round with pit toilets and fresh water.

raw_osm.name: French Beach Provincial Park Group Site

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms French Beach Park is an active year-round campground with fresh water, pit toilets, and a sani-station, supporting potable water as true. A 'Book camping' button and a 'Reservation policies' section listing both frontcountry and group camping confirm reservations are accepted. The OSM name specifies 'Group Site' while the fetched page covers the full park; the operator R.L.C. Enterprize Ltd. and its phone/email appear in OSM but are absent from the BC Parks website, suggesting those contacts belong to the private concessionaire rather than the park itself.
concerns: OSM name specifies 'Group Site' but the fetched URL is the full French Beach Park page with no dedicated group-site content; the group site may be a bookable sub-area rather than a separate facility.

OSM lists operator R.L.C. Enterprize Ltd. with phone 250-474-1336 and email office@rlcparks.ca, but neither appears on the BC Parks website — these contacts likely belong to the private concessionaire and may be outdated or secondary.
OSM carries two different URLs (sookeoutdoors.com and env.gov.bc.ca); only the BC Parks URL was fetched; the sookeoutdoors.com URL was not verified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active BC provincial park campground on the popular Highway 14 / Juan de Fuca cycling corridor, offering year-round camping with potable water and online reservations — a clear fit for the WWC directory.

wow_evidence: 1,600m sand-and-pebble beach... prime whale-watching; open year-round
